name: Suspicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
desc: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. The first time you try to pick up a piece, the tofu falls apart completely. The second time, the tofu and filling separate on the spot... Tempting as the aroma is, after failing twice in a row, you've completely lost the will to try again.

value.text: Suspicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
